sloka: यद्यप्यहं नरेन्द्रेण रहस्यं श्रावितः पुरा ।तथाप्युदाहरिष्यामि दैवं हि दुरतिक्रमम् ।। ७.५०.१८ ॥
transliteration: yadyapyahaṁ narendreṇa rahasyaṁ śrāvitaḥ purā ।tathāpyudāhariṣyāmi daivaṁ hi duratikramam ।। 7.50.18 ॥

translations.english: Although the king (Rama) previously told me this secret, I will nevertheless narrate it, for destiny is indeed difficult to overcome.
